The '''extermination of the Arized homeworld''' was carried out by the [[Vagaari Empire]], which assumed property of the [[Arized]]'s [[Surfeik cruiser]]s after the event.<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The extermination of the Arized homeworld was introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
